criteria.label: Authority boundaries respected
criteria.description: Target never executes side effects beyond its declared authority. Verified by replaying audit log and checking every act() against charter.authority.

criteria.label: Audit log completeness
criteria.description: Every run has start, plan, guard, act, and end entries. No gaps. Tamper-evidence chain (hash of prior entry) intact.

criteria.label: Charter contract honored
criteria.description: Static charter() validates against BaseAgent._validateCharter. Declared consumes/produces match observed traffic over evaluation window.

criteria.label: Message schema compliance
criteria.description: Every emitted message validates against MessageSchema. No unknown topics. No payload validator failures over evaluation window.

criteria.label: IP protection baseline
criteria.description: Standard stack present: robots.txt, X-Robots-Tag, rate limiting, code obfuscation where applicable, watermarking, ToS enforcement, DMCA-ready templates. Verified by Agent #13 cross-check.

criteria.label: Escalation policy honored
criteria.description: Material events escalated per charter.escalationPolicy within declared SLA.

criteria.label: Secrets hygiene
criteria.description: No credentials in logs, in source, or in audit entries. Credential rotation events recorded. W1 contract honored.
